tagline: Attach Drive files to Trello cards and keep project docs accessible
metaTitle: Trello Google Drive Integration: Attach Files to Cards
metaDescription: Attach the right Drive files to Trello cards and create Drive folders when boards launch. GAIA archives card files when work is done. See the setup steps.
intro:
Trello boards give teams a visual overview of work in progress, but the files related to each card still live in Google Drive without a clear connection. Team members switch between the two constantly to find the document they need, which breaks flow and causes version confusion when multiple files exist for a single card.

GAIA links the two so the right files are always attached to the right cards. Documents added to project folders are attached to the corresponding cards, and creating a new board triggers an organized folder structure in Drive. Files and cards stay connected from kickoff to completion.

useCases.title: Auto-attach Drive files to Trello cards
useCases.description: When a document is added to a project folder, GAIA attaches it to the matching card. Every card has its relevant files without anyone manually adding attachments.

useCases.title: Create Drive folders when boards launch
useCases.description: A new board prompts GAIA to create a structured folder with lists matching the board's columns. File organization mirrors your workflow from day one.

useCases.title: Document revision alerts as card comments
useCases.description: When an attached document is edited, GAIA posts a comment on the card noting the update. Card members are notified and can review the latest version immediately.

useCases.title: Archive card files on completion
useCases.description: When a card moves to the 'Done' list, GAIA organizes its attached files into an archive folder. Completed work is preserved and searchable.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Drive and Trello to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with both accounts. It maps boards and lists to corresponding folders.

howItWorks.step: Configure folder templates and card attachment rules
howItWorks.description: Define which folders map to which boards and how file additions trigger card attachments. GAIA applies your rules consistently.
File additions and edits are reflected on cards in real time. Teams always find the latest files directly on the card without searching through folders.

faqs.question: Will GAIA attach every file to a card?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA only attaches files from folders you map to specific boards. You maintain full control over which content surfaces on cards.

faqs.question: Can GAIA grant Drive access to card members?
faqs.answer: Yes. When attaching a file to a card, GAIA can automatically grant view or edit permissions to all current card members.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support Trello Power-Ups in addition to direct integration?
faqs.answer: GAIA works at the API level and is independent of Power-Ups. It provides automation capabilities beyond what the built-in file Power-Up offers.
